events.text: Hey! Interested in buying an old adult bike with a solid frame and good wheels for 150 SAR?
Interested in an old adult bike for 150 SAR? Solid frame and good wheels.

Could come by this evening. What color, brakes OK, any rust on chain or frame? I'll take a look — can do 150 if it's sound.
I’ll relay the conditional interest and ask for the bike details.

Sulaiman could come this evening and pay 150 SAR if the bike is sound; Yousef may be interested at 150 SAR and can come around 19:00 or tomorrow evening. I’ll check whether Sulaiman can meet Asma at 18:30.

Okay. Ask Asma to bring it at 18:30. Tariq will help check brakes and wheels — if it’s sound, I’ll pay 150 SAR.
I’ll confirm the inspection and release the other lead.
